editorial: Looking for an edge‑cutting look at high‑school politics, you’ll find it in this razor‑sharp social drama. Its power plays unfold not on a football field but behind custom books and whispered agreements, giving each corridor its own electric tension. The standout is the unsettling synth‑driven score, turning every hallway into a stage and every sigh into a threat. The film’s pacing slows in the second act, stretching the tension into a languid suspense that could have been tighter. If you love dark, sardonic thrillers that turn cafeteria gossip into a full‑blown revenge saga, this movie is for you.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non‑linear storytelling.
